integrity.claim_scope: Exact combinatorial identity plus analytic asymptotics; finite enumeration is used only as a replay check.
integrity.literature_scope: The defining balanced-purity paper, Scott's uniform-subset definition, and the closest Bell-pair-product analyses were compared at statement level.

scientific_limitations: The theorem is an exact benchmark for products of Bell pairs, not a classification of all states with a given average purity.

Earlier work already observed qualitatively that Bell-pair products can score highly under global-entanglement measures; the originality claim is restricted to the exact uniform-subset profile and central-trinomial balanced asymptotic.
A poorly indexed later source may contain the same coefficient calculation.
title: Exact Bell-pair purity profile for the balanced multipartite potential
